posts.name: MarkJ
posts.cooked:
Had three fun and educational games today.   There can certainly be a bit to keep track of too, as there can be a bit going on at once!

The first games the two of us played three heroes (I played to) and Jemsk 1, followed by two each the last two games.

Had a tough time in game three choosing the Ennead and tougher heroes!  Getting close to death but we just made it, although had to pack up as Good Games was closing - but very likely would've won next turn.  Good experience constantly rotating heroes, villains and environments too although it means learning a new character each time!

 

I played Tempest and Unity the first two games, and Expatriette and The Visionary in the third, against The Ennead and The Final Wasteland.

posts.name: Jemsk
posts.cooked:
It certainly was a fun afternoon!

I had realised when I got home that I had forgotten to apply the nemeses mechanics when I played Ra vs The Ennead. I think it Ra would have been alot closer to death however as would The Ennead!

In the first game I played Legacy (vs Omnitron), Tachyon and Mr Fixer in the second (vs Ambuscade), followed by Ra and Absolute Zero in the third (vs The Ennead).

My intial thoughts on the heroes:

Legacy: very good defender
Tachyon: likes to draw alot of cards
Mr Fixer: inconspicuous 
Ra: really likes fire
Absolute Zero: hurts himself alot

Looking forward to more games - anyone in Melbourne would be welcome to join us!

posts.name: Jemsk
posts.cooked:
I was really keen on playing more games to familiarize myself with the mechanics so last night I played 3 heroes by myself (Bunker, Fanatic (nemesis) and The Scholar) vs Apostate. 

I started at 7pm and finished around 5am in the morning...LOL
 
It was an epic game ... and because I ran out of cards, I ended up having to reshuffle the trash deck once for every hero, twice for the environment and once for the villain. I'm incredibly tired today so I probably won't be doing that again soon. :)
 
I also ended up losing! (Apostate has some really nasty relics and a interesting flip mechanic). He felt like a Level 4 villain when infact he's only a Level 2. 
 
Anyway, it was a good learning experience.
